headlines.title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania outbreak, health officials say
headlines.description: They are the first measles-related deaths in the U.S. this year.

headlines.title: Two deaths reported in Pennsylvania measles outbreak
headlines.description: Two people have died of measles in Pennsylvania, the state’s health department confirmed Tuesday. Both people were unvaccinated. They are the first such deaths in the U.S. this year, and the first in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania in 35 years.

headlines.title: FDA Approves New Blood Test to Identify Signs of Alzheimer’s
headlines.description: The Food and Drug Administration has approved a new blood test to help identify signs of Alzheimer’s disease for people 55 and older who are already showing signs of cognitive decline. The test, from pharmaceutical company Roche and partner Eli Lilly, is a bio-marker blood test.

headlines.title: What is postpartum psychosis? The mental health condition is at the center of the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s lawyers say a rare mental health condition caused her to kill her three children. So what is postpartum psychosis, and why is it so difficult to diagnose and treat? NBC News' Erika Edwards reports.

headlines.title: Rabbi Shares Tips for Navigating Unexpected Challenges
headlines.description: Rabbi Rachel Ain of Sutton Place Synagogue in New York City joins TODAY to talk about the lessons from her upcoming book “Watch How You Go.” She discusses why you should zoom out when you have a stressful day, how to recognize signs that it's time to let go of one priority to focus on another, and more.

headlines.title: We tested dozens of Brooks’ popular sneakers — here’s what we really think (and what can improve)
headlines.description: We’ve tested Brooks shoes for years. These are our favorites, and the ones that didn’t make the cut.

headlines.title: Taking a break from gel polish? These nail strengtheners can help repair damage
headlines.description: The best nail strengtheners prevent nails from splitting, breaking or cracking. Here's how to shop for them with options from OPI, CND and more.

headlines.title: This is a sign that it’s time to replace your running shoes, according to doctors
headlines.description: Running in worn-out shoes can lead to aches, pains and injuries. Podiatrists break down how many miles your running shoes should last and when it’s time for a new pair.

headlines.title: Amazon’s newest Fire tablet is almost 30% off right now — and at its lowest price of the year
headlines.description: The Amazon Fire HD 10 Tablet is $50 off, bringing it to its lowest price of the year. It’s a budget-friendly option with long battery life that’s great for streaming, reading and gaming.

headlines.title: Alfalfa sprouts recalled for E. coli and salmonella after dozens of illnesses in 15 states
headlines.description: Health officials are warning consumers not to eat certain brands of alfalfa sprouts that have been linked to an unusual outbreak involving different disease-causing bacteria.

headlines.title: Eye drops recalled over possible contamination, FDA reports
headlines.description: The FDA reported that bottles of Clear Eyes Maximum Itchy Eye Relief have been recalled over potential contamination.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.
